_what: Segment GUIDs for the three hulls that are assembled from bow/core/stern prefabs. A <SegmentConfiguration><Key> in a .fleet is one of these.
_source: cross-checked against every .fleet in sample fleets/, other info/ and the game Saves/Fleets: 339 segmented ships, 0 unknown GUIDs

_families.Bulk: The Marauder's sections. NLHC's catalog names these pieces `CivBulk - <letter> - <part>`; `hull_sockets.json` carries the full 34-socket table under the prefix `Bulk` and only the 3 sockets that differ under `CivBulk`, so the socket table and the segment GUIDs legitimately use different names.
_families.Container: The CLN and CVLN sections. The asset tree also has `Container Refit - *` bow/core pieces, but no saved hull uses them (0 of 339), so Container Hauler Refit builds from `Container` as well.
